description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These parts are the Suzuki OEM Interior Door Handles, Bezels (cases), Lock Pull, Lock Pull Grommet and Lock Rod for both the LH door and RH door.
This is the only kit on the market that allows 1986-1993 Suzuki Samurai™s to replace the interior door handles while maintaining a functioning interior door lock.
EASY TO INSTALL – Installs from start to finish in 45 minutes
NO MODIFICATIONS – Attaches to Your Existing Latch/Lock
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Lock Pulls
Qty 2 – Lock Pull Grommets
Qty 1 – LH Side Interior Door Handle
Qty 1 – LH Side Door Handle Bezel
Qty 1 – LH Side Lock Rod
Qty 1 – RH Side Interior Door Handle
Qty 1 – RH Side Door Handle Bezel
Qty 1 – RH Side Lock Rod
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1993 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1993 All Models
